title: Binance Will Cease Support for Deposits and Withdrawals of Tokens on Selected Networks - 2025-03-14
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will be ceasing support for deposits and withdrawals of the following tokens via the networks stipulated below from  2025-03-14 08:00 (UTC).  After  2025-03-14 08:00 (UTC) , any deposits sent via the following networks will  not  be credited and may lead to asset loss. Cortex (CTXC) via Ethereum Network NULS (NULS) via BNB Smart Chain UniLend (UFT) via BNB Smart Chain Please note: Users will still be able to deposit or withdraw the above tokens via other networks supported by Binance. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-07
